upsert.notes: Tufts Z-007 intratumoral immunotherapy study for dogs with solid tumors. Public criteria generally require a confirmed measurable tumor about 2–7 cm that can be safely accessed for repeated biopsies; dogs must weigh at least 7 kg. Final eligibility requires Tufts prescreening.

UC Davis CAALM study of subcutaneous canine anti-PD-L1 antibody for dogs with confirmed melanoma or carcinoma that has spread to the lungs. Current public criteria include weight over 15 kg plus additional health and treatment-washout requirements; UC Davis prescreening is required.
